faqs.question: What is the NanoPhotometer N30-Touch used for?
faqs.answer: It's an entry-level microvolume UV/Vis spectrophotometer for fast, reliable nucleic acid and protein quantification from samples as small as 0.3 µl.

faqs.question: Does the N30-Touch need regular recalibration?
faqs.answer: No, sealed optics with True Path Technology guarantee lifetime accuracy without recalibration.

faqs.question: How fast is a full scan?
faqs.answer: 2.5 to 4 seconds across the standard 200-650 nm range, with no lamp warm-up time needed.

faqs.question: What detection range does the standard unit cover?
faqs.answer: dsDNA from 5 to 1,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 44 mg/ml, expandable to 1-16,500 ng/µl and 0.03-478 mg/ml with the Performance Package.

faqs.question: What does the Performance Package add?
faqs.answer: An expanded detection range for DNA and protein measurement, plus a wider full spectrum scan mode extending to 900 nm.

faqs.question: What does the Applications Package add?
faqs.answer: Full access to protein assays (BCA, Bradford, Lowry), kinetics, OD600 cell density, wavescan, standard curve generation, and features like Sample Control™ Technology and dye label measurement.

faqs.question: What does the Connectivity Package add?
faqs.answer: Wi-Fi, USB, HDMI, and LAN connectivity, remote control via PC, tablet, or smartphone, LIMS integration via REST API and Push Service, and 64 GB of onboard data storage.

faqs.question: Can the upgrade packages be added later?
faqs.answer: Yes, Performance, Applications, and Connectivity packages can each be added independently, on the lab's own timeline.

faqs.question: How does Sample Compression Technology work?
faqs.answer: It compresses the sample into a capillary film between two fixed quartz surfaces, removing dependence on surface tension and preventing evaporation during measurement.

body.text: N30-Touch measures from just 0.3 µl, using Sample Compression Technology to form a capillary film between two scratch-resistant, metal-free quartz surfaces, eliminating surface tension issues and evaporation risk during measurement.
True Path Technology holds two fixed anchor points for exact path length, giving recalibration-free accuracy for the lifetime of the instrument.

Standard detection covers dsDNA from 5 to 1,500 ng/µl and BSA from 0.15 to 44 mg/ml, across a 200 to 650 nm scan range, expandable to 1 to 16,500 ng/µl, 0.03 to 478 mg/ml, and 200 to 900 nm with the Performance Package.
A full scan completes in 2.5 to 4 seconds, with no lamp warm-up time needed thanks to the xenon flash lamp, rated for 10⁹ flashes and up to 10 years of service life.
A 7" color touchscreen with adjustable angle runs the onboard NPOS operating system, with an illuminated sample window and easy-to-clean surfaces, including compatibility with alcohol-based solvents.
Three upgrade packages, Performance, Applications, and Connectivity, let the instrument's capabilities expand later without replacing the hardware.
Over 10,000 units are installed globally, and the NanoPhotometer platform is referenced in more than 15,000 scientific publications worldwide.
The instrument carries CE, IEC 61010-1:2012, and EN 61326-1:2013 certification, with a 12-month warranty as standard.

body: Recalibration cycles cost time and, over the life of an instrument, money. N30-Touch's sealed optics remove that recurring task entirely, guaranteeing lifetime accuracy without it.
Sample Compression Technology forms a contained capillary film between two fixed quartz surfaces, removing dependence on surface tension and preventing evaporation throughout the entire measurement.
True Path Technology locks path length in place using two fixed anchor points, so there's no drift to correct for over time, and no costly recalibration visit required.
Durable, inert, scratch-resistant surfaces also mean no reconditioning is needed to keep those surfaces performing accurately.

The Connectivity Package adds Wi-Fi, USB A/B, HDMI, and LAN connections, remote control via PC, tablet, or smartphone, LIMS integration through REST API and Push Service, and 64 GB of onboard data storage.
